descriptions.en: A HACS custom integration for Home Assistant that connects directly over Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) to ICOMON kitchen / coffee scales and reads weight data. It is not part of Home Assistant Core.
descriptions.ko: ICOMON 블루투스(BLE) 주방·커피 저울에 직접 연결해 무게를 읽는 Home Assistant용 HACS 커스텀 통합입니다. Home Assistant Core에 포함된 통합이 아닙니다.

categories_review.source: README Supported devices: ICOMON BLE kitchen/coffee scales for food and beverage preparation. Reviewed Core integration_categories.json ec18d8b25d1ee39aa8b85a72a170e42bee33228c.
